title: HFimpEF · continue GDMT

evidenceNote: Original source grade; recommendation class and evidence level are independent.

title: HF · diuretics for congestion

population: HF with clinical congestion, regardless of EF.
evidenceNote: Original source grade; recommendation class and evidence level are independent.

title: HFrEF · selected ivabradine use

evidenceNote: Original source grade; recommendation class and evidence level are independent.

title: HFrEF · NSAID harm
summary: NSAIDs can worsen HF; avoid or withdraw when possible.
evidenceNote: Original source grade; recommendation class and evidence level are independent.
cautions: Review the medication and indication with a clinician; no automated medication stop instruction.

title: HFpEF · 2026 ACC SGLT2 pathway
summary: The 2026 ACC pathway includes an SGLT2 inhibitor in optimal HFpEF therapy unless contraindicated.
locator: 2026 ACC HFpEF pathway, optimal medical therapy text and Figure 6
evidenceNote: Expert consensus pathway; no formal COR or separate LOE assigned here.
cautions: Expert consensus, not a new Class 1/A recommendation.
Diabetes is not required; renal eligibility, volume status, ketoacidosis risks and product labeling still apply.
Reduced HF events should not be presented as a separately proven HFpEF mortality benefit.

title: HFpEF · 2026 ACC nonsteroidal MRA pathway
summary: The 2026 ACC pathway includes a nonsteroidal MRA (finerenone), unless contraindicated, alongside SGLT2 therapy.
population: Established HFpEF; agent-specific renal and potassium eligibility.
locator: 2026 ACC HFpEF pathway, optimal medical therapy text and Figure 6
evidenceNote: Expert consensus pathway; no formal COR or separate LOE assigned here.
cautions: FDA HF label covers LVEF ≥40%; this consensus record specifically concerns HFpEF.
Finerenone HF initiation: eGFR ≥25 and potassium ≤5.0; check potassium/eGFR at 4 weeks and after dose changes.
Do not automatically add to another MRA. Check strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, adrenal insufficiency and the full label.
VA access is a separate indication-specific CFU/formulary decision.

title: HF across EF · 2026 ESC SGLT2 recommendation
summary: Dapagliflozin or empagliflozin is recommended for symptomatic HF across EF to reduce HF hospitalization or CV death.
locator: 2026 ESC HF guideline, Recommendation Table 5: SGLT2 inhibitor row
evidenceNote: Original source grade; recommendation class and evidence level are independent.
cautions: ESC grading is shown separately from US guideline grading.
In HFpEF, the composite benefit is driven primarily by fewer HF hospitalizations; assess drug-specific eligibility.

title: HF across EF · 2026 ESC MRA recommendation
summary: MRA therapy is recommended: steroidal MRA for HFrEF; steroidal or nonsteroidal MRA for HFpEF.
locator: 2026 ESC HF guideline, Recommendation Table 5: MRA row
evidenceNote: Original source grade; recommendation class and evidence level are independent.
cautions: Do not combine MRA agents routinely. The guideline cautions with eGFR <25 and potassium ≥5.0.
Use each product’s labeled renal/potassium criteria and monitoring; US VA access remains separate.

title: Prior MI · reassess long-term beta blocker indication
